decisions.reason: As the flagship of the firm's organic push with several variants, the organic salami platter is central to its strategy and close to its core curing competence.
The organic poultry mini salami snacks fit the organic and snacking direction, but as a single niche item they face higher retailer delisting risk two years after launch.
The premium sharing salami line uses the firm's maturation strengths in a growing convenience segment, and its several variants allow adjustment rather than withdrawal.
The organic Fleischwurst was only recently launched as a staple addition to the organic team and builds on established processing know-how.
The newly launched organic thinly sliced chicken breast line in two flavors extends organic poultry formats and fits the firm's expansion plans.
The organic herb-coated salami is a recent launch close to the core salami offer with its own page, so keeping it is likely while it builds listings.
